# `lakana deploys`

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the Typer app. Do not edit by hand:
run `uv run python scripts/generate_reference.py` and commit the result. -->

Usage: `lakana deploys [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Deploy history.

## `lakana deploys list`

Usage: `lakana deploys list [OPTIONS]`

List deploy history, newest first.

A long list prints a "More results" line with the command that shows the next page.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--repo` | text | none | Only this repository. |
| `--limit` | whole number, 1 to 200 | none | Most deploys to list (default 100). |
| `--cursor` | text | none | Continue after the page that printed this cursor. |

## `lakana deploys show`

Usage: `lakana deploys show [OPTIONS] {deploy_id}`

Show deploy DEPLOY_ID.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DEPLOY_ID` | text | required |  |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
